modern: And they will curse virtue, speaking harsh words.
original: And virtue they will curse, speaking harsh words.
notification: And they will curse virtue, speaking harsh words.
notification_original: And virtue they will curse, speaking harsh words.

explained.summary: A line Marcus copied from an old poet: people will blame virtue itself and speak harshly of it. Even goodness gets attacked. He seems to be reminding himself not to expect doing the right thing to win approval, and not to be shaken when it draws criticism instead.
